{{Top|leg}}
'''Teaching Guides''' were teachers on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kegan/Legends|Kegan]]. The strict instructors, like [[O-Bin]], taught students [[The Learning]] curriculum at the [[Learning Circle]], outside the city limits of Kegan. The Teaching Guides worked with other Guides at the school including the [[Truant Guide]]s, who made sure no students skipped school, and the [[Security Guide]]s, who enforced behavior and ensured students did not escape the school bounds.<ref name="The Fight for Truth>''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Fight for Truth]]''</ref>
